clips.title: The story
paras: Near Deathknell, The Adventurer is sent to investigate a stranger by the road to Brill. Scarlet Crusaders threaten the region, but the stranger is Eleanor Shackleton, a Forsaken traveler with wilderness skills to share.

Executor Arren watches Deathknell and the roads around it. Scarlet Crusaders spy on the region and infiltrate northern Lordaeron, so an unfamiliar figure near Brill draws suspicion. You have proved your dedication by striking at Crusader threats along the border. Now Arren asks you to investigate the stranger quietly and learn whether she threatens the Forsaken.

You find Eleanor Shackleton by the roadside near Brill. She is a Forsaken traveler, pausing before another journey into the wilds, with no Crusader plot or Scourge necromancy in mind. Eleanor sees a fellow adventurer in those sent to check on her. She offers to teach you how to survive in open country and make camp.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, you have proven yourself trustworthy in your endeavors against the Scarlet Crusade so far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.
I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Brill. Go and see what she's doing.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm not affiliated with the Scarlet Crusade, if you couldn't tell. I'm just an adventurer stopping by before my next venture into the wilderness.
Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
